validation_notes:
Обработано 14 людей из CSV по тикеру MOEX. Проверено 2 локальных документа: годовой отчет MOEX_AR2024_RUS.pdf и консолидированная финансовая отчетность Summary MICEX-RTS_FS_4Q2024_RUS.pdf. Выполнено 14 персональных research rounds; для всех людей проведен отдельный поиск образования, предыдущего опыта, назначений, профессиональных биографий и однофамильцев. Образование найдено для всех 14, но у Olga Melentyeva, Paul Bodart и Ramon Morales Adarraga оно основано на более слабых вторичных источниках. Существенная неопределенность у 4 людей: Yuriy Denisov из-за смены председателя Правления в конце 2024 года; Andrei Selyuk из-за конфликта CSV с официальным CFO 2024 Михаилом Панфиловым; Olga Melentyeva из-за отсутствия полной официальной биографии; Paul Bodart/Ramon Morales Adarraga из-за отсутствия официального MOEX CV 2024. Использовались слабые источники MarketScreener, LETOPIS и профессиональные профили там, где официальные документы редактированы или биографии недоступны. Главные конфликты: CEO Denisov/Zhidkov, CFO Selyuk/Panfilov, устаревшие вторичные сведения по некоторым образованиям. Исключены однофамильцы: Sergey Shvetsov-физик, Dmitry A. Shcheglov-историк, Anton Vladimirovich Terentiev-историческое лицо, Aleksandr Izosimov-боксер, академические и соцсетевые профили Olga Melentyeva/Paul Bodart/Ramon без связи с MOEX. Поиск считается завершенным, потому что локальные документы проверены до веб-поиска, официальные MOEX и раскрытия прочитаны, причины отсутствия полного 2024 персонального состава зафиксированы, два последующих веб-прохода не дали более высокого официального источника по редактированным биографиям.

ROUND 2 (2026-07-19, gap-fill + GICS/qualification_degree/institution normalization, per REFINEMENT.md / gap-fill task). Round 2 (gap-filling pass, 2026-07-19): re-checked local filings (MOEX_AR2024_RUS.pdf, full-text extracted and grepped for all 14 names -- only Denisov, Shvetsov and Kamenskiy actually appear in that document; no new local material for the other 11) before conducting one additional targeted web-research round per person, scoped only to fields already null/vague/flagged as uncertain in round 1 (per gap-filling task instructions; already-confirmed facts were not re-verified). New facts confirmed and added: Denisov's previously-undocumented 2010-2011 Deputy CEO stint at Moscow Exchange and NCC supervisory-board role (moex.com/n23618, already-cited primary source, re-fetched); Denisov's Vnesheconombank end_year (1992, inferred from explicit continuity in the same official biography); Selyuk's education year (1996, ict-online.ru, cross-corroborated by 4 independent outlets) and Russian Post start_year (2019, same source); Selyuk's single vague 1998-2018 combined-employer entry split into 5 precisely-dated entries (Arthur Andersen/EY, MegaFon, Golden Telecom/VimpelCom, Yota, Gallery), all per ict-online.ru; Burilov's single vague 2002-2020 combined-employer entry split into 4 precisely-dated entries (Deutsche Bank, Renaissance Capital, Sberbank-Technologies, SMP Bank), per globalcio.ru; Izosimov's INSEAD MBA year (1995, corroborated by The Moscow Times, M.Video-Eldorado press materials and Grokipedia); Goreglyad's Doctor of Economic Sciences award year (2002) and specific professorial affiliation (MSU Higher School of State Audit), both from wiki.letopis.ru. Gaps that remained unresolved after this round's additional research (left null/Unknown rather than guessed, per the project's anti-invention rule): Melentyeva's education year and employment dates (a namesake-risk secondary source with a mismatched patronymic was found and explicitly rejected); Kamenskiy's INSEAD completion year; Shcheglov's Candidate of Technical Sciences award year; Terentiev's MEPhI graduation year (one candidate figure, 2007, could not be corroborated on follow-up and was rejected) and pre-2017 employer dates (official source gives only an elapsed-years figure, not exact dates); Shvetsov's National Settlement Depository board tenure dates and HSE professorship dates; Bodart's INSEAD graduation year (extensive multi-engine search, including a direct re-fetch of the ECMI biography PDF, found nothing); Morales Adarraga's graduation year; Lykov's VEB.RF tenure dates and exact MSU program (a materially conflicting secondary aggregator biography, rus.team, was found and rejected as a probable namesake/unreliable-source risk rather than incorporated, since it contradicts the already-established MSU/Vienna identity from round 1). GICS classification added this round: company-level and all professional_experience entries for all 14 people now carry sector/industry_group/industry copied verbatim from gics_taxonomy.json, classifying each organization by its own primary line of business (e.g. Sberbank-Technologies as IT Services rather than inheriting Sberbank's Banks classification; BNY Mellon as Capital Markets rather than Banks, per GICS's actual custody/asset-servicing treatment). Entries that bundle multiple organizations spanning different GICS industries (e.g. Selyuk's Golden Telecom/VimpelCom, Izosimov's Mars/McKinsey/M.Video-Eldorado, Terentiev's Gazprombank/Verno Capital/Kazimir Partners) were left null/null/null with an explanation rather than forcing a single inaccurate bucket, consistent with the convention already established across other tickers in this project (e.g. GLTR, ENPG, BELU). Government bodies and the central bank (Bank of Russia, Ministry of Finance, Audit Chamber, Federation Council) were also left null/null/null as non-GICS-classifiable, consistent with existing project convention. qualification_degree added to every education/degrees entry for all 14 people: Soviet/pre-Bologna Russian 5-year university programs mapped to Specialist degree; Candidate/Doctor of Sciences mapped to Doctoral degree; Executive MBA mapped to MBA (consistent with project convention); a genuine non-MBA business-school leadership programme (Kamenskiy's INSEAD) mapped to Executive education; a director's certification (Kamenskiy's IoD) mapped to Professional certification; cases where institution attendance is confirmed but the specific program/degree level is not disclosed anywhere found (Melentyeva, Lykov, Morales Adarraga) mapped to Unknown rather than guessed.
